Colon and Rectal Cancer Clinical and Virome Data

Source: R/data.R
crc_virome.Rd

A dataset containing cleaned key clinical, survival, and virome abundance data for patients with colon and rectal adenocarcinoma from the TCGA PanCancer Atlas study.

Usage

crc_virome

Format

A data frame with patient data in rows and variables in columns:

sample_id

Unique TCGA patient identifier.

time_months

Overall survival time in months, censored at 60 months.

status

Overall survival status: 1 for deceased, 0 for alive.

age

Age of the patient at diagnosis.

sex

Sex of the patient.

race

Race of the patient.

ethnicity

Ethnicity of the patient.

stage

AJCC pathologic tumor stage.

Normalised abundance for the Alfamovirus genus.

Source

The data was sourced, cleaned, and merged from the supplementary materials of Smyth et al. (2024) [https://doi.org/10.1002/cam4.70434], originating from the cBioPortal for Cancer Genomics ('TCGA, PanCancer Atlas' study).
